_note: I048: part-note corrections found while writing docs/code/player.md. (1) The four StartBackstep* notes said 'moving down/up/right/left backwards'; by PlayerFacingByAnim and PlayerMoveDirByAnim a backstep keeps the facing it is named for and moves the opposite way (anim $05 faces down and moves up, $07 faces up and moves down, $09 faces left and moves right, $0B faces right and moves left; ChoosePlayerAction reaches them from the down, up, left and right facing rows with the opposite key while L or R is held). (2) StartIdleUp named the hero 'Blazer' (the walkthrough never names him; the hero is called 'the hero') and cited the planning file FM-A10 instead of the tables. (3) RunSoulOrbController said it runs 'just before the orb'; RunSoulOrb spawns it with COP 85 (Cop85_SpawnActorBefore), which puts the new actor right after its caller in run order (docs/code/actor-system.md, OQ-I044-4), and the note itself says the orb is its $3C link (the actor that runs earlier).

partNotes.StartBackstepDown: Backstep pose: the hero faces down and walks up (anim $05, no armed variant; PlayerFacingByAnim 1, PlayerMoveDirByAnim 0, step velocity dy = -2). Reached from the down-facing rows of PlayerActionTable with the Up key while L or R is held. Family note: StartIdleUp.
partNotes.StartBackstepLeft: Backstep pose: the hero faces left and walks right (anim $09, no armed variant; PlayerFacingByAnim 3, PlayerMoveDirByAnim 2). Reached from the left-facing rows of PlayerActionTable with the Right key while L or R is held. Family note: StartIdleUp.
partNotes.StartBackstepRight: Backstep pose: the hero faces right and walks left (anim $0B, no armed variant; PlayerFacingByAnim 2, PlayerMoveDirByAnim 3). Reached from the right-facing rows of PlayerActionTable with the Left key while L or R is held. Family note: StartIdleUp.
partNotes.StartBackstepUp: Backstep pose: the hero faces up and walks down (anim $07, no armed variant; PlayerFacingByAnim 0, PlayerMoveDirByAnim 1). Reached from the up-facing rows of PlayerActionTable with the Down key while L or R is held. Family note: StartIdleUp.
partNotes.StartIdleUp:
Starts the idle pose facing up; the first of the 28 pose handlers of the player state table (PlayerActionTable).

When: the player script picks a handler from PlayerActionTable (44 rows of 6 words) whenever the pose must change; carry clear = no weapon drawn or L/R held (poses $00-$13), carry set = armed without L/R (poses $24-$2B). ChoosePlayerAction chooses the row (see the block note of player_core).
Sees: the hero standing, walking or stepping with the matching animation.
Why: one tiny handler per pose keeps the 44-row table free of animation ids. Names: Start + pose + facing (PlayerFacingByAnim: 0 up, 1 down, 2 right, 3 left); the sidestep names give the facing, then the direction of travel, and a backstep keeps the facing in its name while it moves the other way; anim $01 unarmed or $2B armed here.
In: X = player actor, carry from the state table.
Out: PublishPlayerAnim, COP 80 and COP 82 (set and step the animation), then BRL ChoosePlayerAction back into the common player loop.
Clobbers: A, Y.

partNotes.RunSoulOrbController:
Steers the orb's centre and circles the orb around it.

When: spawned by RunSoulOrb (COP 85, so it runs right after the orb in the same frame); every frame, also in sub-frames ($16 bit $0010).
Sees: the d-pad moves the orb around the hero independently of him; it trails behind and circles (walkthrough items.md: a soul reveals hidden passages 'as your orb of light circles over them').
Why: the orb can be parked in front of enemies, and the spells start at the orb.
In: actor script, X = own slot (PHX / PLX around the body); reads joy_pressed, player_x, player_y, soul_orbit_phase, SineTable and SineTableTail.
Out: DispatchSpellCast first (carry set: nothing more this frame). The d-pad moves this actor 2 px per frame per axis; a pull toward the hero adds 1 px, 2 px at 80 px or more distance to the right or below, 96 px to the left and 64 px above; the new centre is stored in $00 and $02. The orb actor (the $3C link) gets the centre + (sine x / 4, cosine y / 4): a circle of radius 31 px, 128 phases per turn.
Clobbers: A, Y (= the orb), dp$16, dp$18; X restored.
